study: Local sensitivity of the frozen Guosheng ETF macro rotation
primary_question: Does small feasible movement of rebalance timing, covariance lookback, or macro signal parameters leave a neighborhood of similar results?
strategies: Frozen GS monthly six-asset map; fixed V12 contemporaneous comparator. Diagnose sensitivity and do not select a new winner.
account: Reuse the audited shared engine, 1m RMB, commission 1.5bp minimum 5 RMB, modeled one-way slippage 9bp. Dates align at every start. Amount fills at close, actual ETF price proxy fills at next open.
actual_risk_history: Use earlier real return history for each selected, already listed fund even before the common six-ETF price matrix. Values on and after the common return start must equal the original audited fund returns. No proxy is allowed in actual risk estimation. If a scheduled target cannot be estimated, record the entire scenario as unavailable for that start and the exact cause.

schedule.rule: First through fifteenth trading day of every calendar month. If the whole month is shorter, clamp to its last session; never clamp to an incomplete terminal month. All accounts independently build their baseline portfolio on the shared start; subsequent months are scheduled.
secondary: last trading day of each completed month
each Monday's first session of ISO week
first session of each calendar quarter
schedule.delay_rule: Freeze the original month-start target based on the previous trading day and execute the same target 1/2/3/5 exchange sessions later. Keep that portfolio through the month until the next scheduled target. Keep original two-step refill. Shared initial portfolio at account start.
schedule.diagnostic: Schedules use calendar trading positions, not future asset prices. The last trading day comes from the exchange calendar. Different signal reading dates allow then-known new announcements.

stress.fcf_clean: Strictly mask any 980092 returns before 2024-08-16 from risk estimation, as well as no allocation or P&L until a full trailing window. Equal initial cash reserve for the excluded component in original phase as in prior cutoff study. Include baseline, the fixed joint grid, and all credit/PMI one-parameter variants for the two amount starts. No other historical proxy changes.
stress.without_best_year: Report CAGR after excluding 2025 for each strategy on same days, with actual selected days and year count excluded.

evaluation.calendar_anchor: Compare continuous path subwindows with a previous-close reference, and same funded cold starts as separate context.
evaluation.near_plateau: For 0–4 trading days after month-start times 56/63/70 risk, each window's CAGR spread, medians, losses relative to baseline, maximum drawdown spread and pass rates. Apply the user's definition by reporting positive margin over V12 and drawdown within 5pp, plus a descriptive +3pp return-margin screen and note that +3pp is a diagnostic rather than an agreed mandate.
evaluation.isolated_peak_diagnostic: Relative to frozen center, report close-neighbor signed differences, whether both sides are below center where defined, and warn if adjacent realizable changes cause >3pp CAGR losses. For a parameter with center on date boundary, use previous month-end and one or two sessions after month-start as neighbors. Do not infer generalization from in-sample plateau or sharpness.
evaluation.timing_attribution: Trace common month target basket changes and paired monthly log excess. Report the short-sample terminal period and the largest calendar-month differences, along with whether a dated macro release was crossed.
